lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular nodes posterior to the gills; horizontal rows exhibit increasing spatial separation along the anterior-to-posterior axis (right to left).
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot rows to form a lattice-like arrangement of high-luminance anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with bright superior edges and shadowed inferior boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs scattered across the visible surface of the dorsal fin silhouette.
